narrative.details:
The Order of the Silver Hand was utterly decimated when Uther was slain.

The boy held out for as long as he could. Pushed to the war torn hamlet of Northdale, he made his final stand.

Were any of the Order left alive, he thought - and did it matter?

It was with that thought that Taelan threw down the standard of the Order and renounced all that he had known. His honor left upon the blood soaked ground of Northdale.

You must travel to Northdale and recover that symbol of lost honor.
narrative.objectives: Travel to Northdale, in the northeastern region of the Eastern Plaguelands, and recover the Symbol of Lost Honor. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.
narrative.offerRewardText:
It is as glorious now - even in its tattered state - as the day I looked upon it and took my oath of allegiance.

His redemption comes and perhaps mine with it...
narrative.requestItemsText: My faith will guide you, adventurer. The Light knows no bounds.

quests.objectiveText: Slay 20 Plaguehound Runts, 5 Plaguehounds and 5 Frenzied Plaguehounds.

quests.objectiveText: Slay 30 Plaguebats and return to Tirion Fordring.

quests.objectiveText: Seek out the Carrion Grubs and Devourers of the region.

quests.name: Redemption
quests.objectiveText: Listen to what Tirion Fordring has to say.

quests.name: Of Forgotten Memories
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the Undercroft - at the southernmost section of the Eastern Plaguelands - and recover Taelan's Hammer.

quests.name: Of Love and Family
quests.objectiveText: Travel to island of Caer Darrow, in the south-central region of the Plaguelands, and look for any clues as to the whereabouts of the painting.

quests.name: Of Love and Family
